result.instructions: Tools for All Quiet, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes All Quiet data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run allquiet_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run allquiet_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run allquiet_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. allquiet_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: allquiet_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: Search/list incidents with filters (status, severity, team, user, search term, archived/snoozed, date range) and pagination. All Quiet: GET /v1/incident/search/list.

unattended.description: Filter to incidents with no acknowledging user.

createdFrom.description: ISO8601 lower bound on creation time.

createdUntil.description: ISO8601 upper bound on creation time.

tools.name: allquiet_get_incident
tools.title: Get incident
tools.description: Get a single incident by its id. All Quiet: GET /v1/incident/search/{incidentId}.

tools.name: allquiet_get_incident_markdown
tools.title: Get incident as markdown
tools.description: Get a markdown rendering of a single incident by its id (useful for pasting into a doc or chat). All Quiet: GET /v1/incident/search/{incidentId}/markdown.

tools.name: allquiet_who_is_on_call
tools.title: Who is on call
tools.description: Get who is currently (or at a given point in time) on call, optionally filtered by team/user. All Quiet: GET /v1/on-call.

timestamp.description: ISO8601 point-in-time to check (defaults to now).

tools.name: allquiet_on_call_report
tools.title: On-call report
tools.description: Get a summed on-call duration report over a time window, optionally filtered by user/team/escalation tier. All Quiet: GET /v1/on-call-report/sum.

start.description: ISO8601 start of the report window (required).

end.description: ISO8601 end of the report window (required).

maxTier.description: Only include escalation tiers up to this number.

tools.name: allquiet_list_teams
tools.title: List teams
tools.description: Search/list teams, optionally filtered by display name. All Quiet: GET /v1/team/search/list.

tools.name: allquiet_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: Search/list users, optionally filtered by email or display name. All Quiet: GET /v1/user/search/list.

tools.name: allquiet_list_on_call_overrides
tools.title: List on-call overrides
tools.description: Search/list on-call overrides for a given user. All Quiet: GET /v1/on-call-override/search/list.

userId.description: The user id to list overrides for (required).

tools.name: allquiet_create_incident
tools.title: Create incident
tools.description: Creates a new incident on the LIVE account (may trigger alerting/paging). `status` and `severity` are free-form strings the API validates against your account's configuration — common `severity` values include "Warning", "Minor", "Major", "Critical", and `status` reflects the incident lifecycle (e.g. "Open"/"Resolved"); confirm the valid values for your account before calling. All Quiet: POST /v1/incident.

status.description: Incident status (required) — free-form, validated by the API; reflects the incident lifecycle (e.g. "Open"/"Resolved"). Confirm valid values for your account.

severity.description: Incident severity (required) — free-form, validated by the API; common values include "Warning", "Minor", "Major", "Critical". Confirm valid values for your account.

messageIsPublic.description: Whether the message is visible on a public status page.

teamIds.description: Ids of teams to associate with the incident.

integrationId.description: Id of the integration that should own/route the incident.

tools.name: allquiet_update_incident
tools.title: Update incident
tools.description: Applies an operation to an existing LIVE incident: change its severity and/or append an intent (a lifecycle action such as acknowledge/resolve/reopen/snooze — a status transition). At least one of `changeSeverity` or `appendIntent` is required. All Quiet: PATCH /v1/incident/{incidentId}.

changeSeverity.description: New severity to set on the incident.

appendIntent.description: Lifecycle action/intent to append (e.g. acknowledge/resolve/reopen/snooze — a status transition). Confirm valid values for your account.

intentMessage.description: Optional message to attach to the appended intent.

tools.name: allquiet_create_on_call_override
tools.title: Create on-call override
tools.description: Creates an on-call override for a user on the LIVE account (temporarily changes who is on call). `type` is a free-form override kind and `start`/`end` govern the override window — confirm the valid `type` values for your account. All Quiet: POST /v1/on-call-override.

userId.description: The user id the override applies to (required).

type.description: Override kind (required) — free-form, validated by the API. Confirm valid values for your account.

teamId.description: Team id the override applies within.

escalationTier.description: Escalation tier the override applies to.

replacementUserIds.description: Ids of the replacement user(s) on call.

start.description: ISO8601 start of the override window.

end.description: ISO8601 end of the override window.
